items.subject: Your YouTube subscription will be cancelled
items.summary: Google Play confirms that the YouTube Premium subscription purchased on 13 September is now scheduled to end on 13 October 2026, with no refund.
items.action: Confirm the cancellation was intentional. If you want to keep YouTube Premium, renew it through Google Play before 13 October 2026.
items.decisionNeeded: Decide whether to let YouTube Premium end on 13 October 2026 or renew it before then.
